note: Daylight mode: a new high-contrast display option for using the app outdoors in bright sun. One tap on the Daylight button in the header (or Preferences - Display - High contrast) switches to a black-on-white palette with heavier borders, bolder small type, and darker, thicker chart lines. It layers on top of whichever theme you use, and follows your device's increase-contrast setting if you leave it on Follow system. Display only - physics and designs untouched.
